context.en-US: CCL20 (MIP-3alpha) is a CC chemokine that signals exclusively through the receptor CCR6, belonging to the broader chemokine family that directs leukocyte trafficking. Its classification as a chemokine situates it among the SASP components that recruit immune cells to senescent tissue. As a SASP factor, CCL20 extends the communicative reach of senescent cells to adaptive immunity, attracting CCR6-expressing cells such as TH17 lymphocytes and immature dendritic cells. Its restricted receptor usage gives it a focused recruitment profile distinct from broadly acting chemokines.
context.zh-TW: CCL20（MIP-3alpha）是一種專一透過受體 CCR6 訊號的 CC 趨化因子，屬於引導白血球遷移的更廣趨化因子家族。其歸類為趨化因子將它置於招募免疫細胞至衰老組織的 SASP 成分中。作為 SASP 因子，CCL20 擴展衰老細胞對適應性免疫的溝通觸及，吸引表達 CCR6 的細胞如 TH17 淋巴球與未成熟樹突細胞。其受限的受體使用賦予其不同於廣泛作用趨化因子的聚焦招募輪廓。

context.en-US: CCL20 is the sole ligand for CCR6, a Gai-coupled GPCR that drives chemotaxis via PI3K/Akt, p38 MAPK, and calcium flux in target cells. This exclusive pairing directs recruitment of CCR6-positive cells such as TH17 lymphocytes and dendritic cells to sites of ligand production. In the senescence context, CCL20-CCR6 links the SASP to adaptive immune infiltration, shaping the local immune landscape around senescent foci. The signaling mechanism is well characterized in lymphocyte biology and is a canonical chemokine-receptor interaction.
context.zh-TW: CCL20 是 CCR6 的唯一配體，CCR6 是一種經由 PI3K/Akt、p38 MAPK 與鈣流驅動趨化性的 Gai 耦合 GPCR。此專一配對引導 CCR6 陽性細胞如 TH17 淋巴球與樹突細胞招募至配體產生部位。在衰老脈絡中，CCL20-CCR6 將 SASP 連結到適應性免疫浸潤，塑造衰老灶周圍的局部免疫景觀。此訊號機制在淋巴球生物學中確立良好，且是典型的趨化因子—受體交互作用。

context.en-US: CCL20 is a SASP chemokine that contributes to paracrine growth arrest in neighbouring cells and to immune recruitment. As part of the secretome it broadens the range of leukocyte subsets drawn to senescent foci, complementing the classical IL-6/IL-8 signals. Its inclusion highlights the chemokine diversity of the SASP and reinforces both arrest-spreading and immune surveillance functions of senescent cells. Expression is driven by NF-kB and is inducible by IL-1alpha, IL-1beta, and TNF-alpha, embedding it in the IL-1-centered inflammatory cascade.
context.zh-TW: CCL20 是一種貢獻鄰近細胞旁分泌生長停滯與免疫招募的 SASP 趨化因子。作為分泌組的一部分，它擴寬被招募至衰老灶的白血球子集範圍，補充經典 IL-6/IL-8 訊號。其納入凸顯 SASP 的趨化因子多樣性，並強化衰老細胞的停滯擴散與免疫監視功能。其表現由 NF-κB 驅動，且可被 IL-1alpha、IL-1beta 與 TNF-alpha 誘發，將其嵌入以 IL-1 為中心的發炎級聯。

context.en-US: CCL20 is among the SASP components that autocrinely reinforce senescence and induce paracrine arrest in receiving cells, contributing to the spread of the arrested phenotype. By recruiting immune cells and modulating the local milieu, it supports the transmissible nature of senescence and expands the reach of the secretome. Its contribution is one of several cooperative SASP factors that together ensure robust spreading of growth arrest. The relationship is well supported in senescence models and connects chemokine signaling to cell-cycle regulation.
context.zh-TW: CCL20 是自我強化衰老並誘發受體細胞旁分泌停滯、貢獻停滯表型擴散的 SASP 成分之一。透過招募免疫細胞並調節局部微環境，它支持衰老的可傳播性並擴展分泌組的觸及。其貢獻是協作確保強健生長停滯擴散的多種 SASP 因子之一。此關係在衰老模型良好支持，並將趨化因子訊號連結到細胞週期調節。

context.en-US: CCL20 expression is driven by NF-kB and induced by IL-1alpha, IL-1beta, and TNF-alpha, placing it downstream of the apical SASP amplifiers. This positions CCL20 within the IL-1alpha-centered feed-forward loop of senescence inflammation, in which a single upstream cytokine orchestrates a broad chemokine response. Its induction integrates the master inflammatory cytokines with chemokine output, ensuring immune recruitment is coordinated with secretome activation. The relationship is mechanistically coherent and well documented across senescence and inflammatory models.
context.zh-TW: CCL20 表現由 NF-κB 驅動，並被 IL-1alpha、IL-1beta 與 TNF-alpha 誘發，將其置於頂層 SASP 放大器的下游。這將 CCL20 定位於 IL-1alpha 中心的衰老發炎正向迴圈中，其中單一上游細胞激素協調廣泛趨化因子反應。其誘發整合主發炎細胞激素與趨化因子輸出，確保免疫招募與分泌組活化協調。此關係在機制上連貫，並跨衰老與發炎模型良好記載。

context.en-US: The CCL20-CCR6 axis links the SASP to adaptive immunity by recruiting TH17 cells, which express CCR6 and are drawn to CCL20-rich senescent foci. TH17 recruitment can amplify local inflammation and shape the immune milieu around senescent cells, promoting chronic inflammatory responses. This connects the secretome to a distinct T-cell subset with pro-inflammatory roles and expands the immunological consequences of the SASP beyond innate immune activation. The relationship highlights how chemokines translate senescence signals into adaptive immune skewing.
context.zh-TW: CCL20-CCR6 軸透過招募表達 CCR6 並被吸引至富含 CCL20 衰老灶的 TH17 細胞，將 SASP 連結到適應性免疫。TH17 招募可放大局部發炎並塑造衰老細胞周圍的免疫微環境，促進慢性發炎反應。這將分泌組連結到具促發炎角色的不同 T 細胞子集，並擴展 SASP 超越先天免疫活化的免疫學後果。此關係凸顯趨化因子如何將衰老訊號轉化為適應性免疫偏移。

context.en-US: CCL20-mediated immune recruitment can contribute to chronic inflammation and age-related tissue dysfunction by drawing TH17 and other CCR6-positive cells into senescent tissue niches. Through sustained chemotactic signaling, CCL20 supports the low-grade inflammation that characterizes inflammaging, amplifying the effects of the SASP over time. Its contribution is one node in the broader SASP-inflammaging axis, linking local senescent foci to systemic inflammatory states. Confidence is moderate, as the specific CCL20-TH17 role in aging is still being defined.
context.zh-TW: CCL20 介導的免疫招募可透過將 TH17 與其他 CCR6 陽性細胞吸入衰老組織微環境，貢獻慢性發炎與年齡相關組織功能障礙。透過持續趨化訊號，CCL20 支持特徵為 inflammaging 的低程度發炎，隨時間放大 SASP 的效應。其貢獻是更廣 SASP-inflammaging 軸中的一個節點，將局部衰老灶連結到全身性發炎狀態。信度中等，因 CCL20-TH17 在老化中的特定角色仍在定義中。

context.en-US: CDKN2B encodes p15INK4b, a cyclin-dependent kinase inhibitor that blocks CDK4/6 and thereby enforces G1 arrest. As a tumor-suppressor locus often co-regulated with CDKN2A at chromosome 9p21, its product is a core effector of growth inhibition in response to TGFbeta signaling. In senescence, CDKN2B induction is a key event in paracrine and TGFbeta-driven arrest, acting downstream of SMAD3/SMAD4. The encoding relationship is a fundamental gene-to-protein fact with direct relevance to cell-cycle control.
context.zh-TW: CDKN2B 編碼 p15INK4b，一種阻斷 CDK4/6 從而強制 G1 停滯的細胞週期依賴激酶抑制因子。作為常與 CDKN2A 在染色體 9p21 共調節的腫瘤抑制基因座，其產物是對 TGFbeta 訊號生長抑制的核心效應器。在衰老中，CDKN2B 誘發是旁分泌與 TGFbeta 驅動停滯的關鍵事件，作用於 SMAD3/SMAD4 下游。此編碼關係是對細胞週期控制直接相關的基本基因—蛋白事實。

context.en-US: p15INK4b specifically binds and inhibits CDK4 and CDK6, preventing cyclin D-CDK complex formation and Rb phosphorylation. This enforces a G1 cell-cycle block that is central to paracrine and oncogene-induced senescence, and its action parallels p16INK4a, providing redundant CDK inhibition. The inhibition is direct and is a canonical mechanism of the INK4 family of CDK inhibitors. By maintaining hypophosphorylated Rb, p15 keeps E2F transcription factors sequestered and silences S-phase genes, ensuring durable arrest.
context.zh-TW: p15INK4b 特異結合並抑制 CDK4 與 CDK6，防止 cyclin D-CDK 複合體形成與 Rb 磷酸化。這強制對旁分泌與致癌基因誘發衰老至為核心的 G1 細胞週期封鎖，且其作用與 p16INK4a 平行，提供冗餘 CDK 抑制。此抑制直接，且是 INK4 家族 CDK 抑制因子的典型機制。透過維持低磷酸化 Rb，p15 使 E2F 轉錄因子隔離並靜默 S 期基因，確保持久停滯。

context.en-US: p15INK4b maintains Rb in its hypophosphorylated, growth-suppressive state by inhibiting CDK4/6, thereby keeping Rb bound to and repressing E2F target genes. This sustains the G1 arrest that defines the senescent phenotype and locks cells out of the cell cycle. Along with p16, p15 provides durable CDK inhibition that reinforces the Rb-E2F checkpoint, a central node of senescence enforcement. The relationship is a standard INK4-Rb axis fact and explains how CDK inhibition translates into stable growth arrest.
context.zh-TW: p15INK4b 透過抑制 CDK4/6 維持 Rb 於其低磷酸化、生長抑制狀態，從而保持 Rb 結合並抑制 E2F 標的基因。這維持定義衰老表型的 G1 停滯並將細胞鎖出細胞週期。與 p16 一起，p15 提供持久 CDK 抑制以強化 Rb-E2F 檢查點，這是衰老執行的中心節點。此關係是標準的 INK4-Rb 軸事實，並解釋 CDK 抑制如何轉化為穩定生長停滯。

context.en-US: CDKN2B is a direct transcriptional target of TGFbeta signaling: SMAD3/SMAD4 complexes bind SMAD-binding elements at the CDKN2B promoter to induce p15INK4b. This couples TGFbeta-family ligands, including Activin A and TGF-beta1, to CDK inhibition and growth arrest. The induction is a principal mechanism by which TGFbeta drives paracrine senescence and is essential for transmissible arrest in receiving cells. It is a well-established SMAD-dependent transcriptional event, validated by TGFBR1 inhibitor and knockout studies.
context.zh-TW: CDKN2B 是 TGFbeta 訊號的直接轉錄標的：SMAD3/SMAD4 複合體結合 CDKN2B 啟動子的 SMAD 結合元件以誘發 p15INK4b。這將包括 Activin A 與 TGF-beta1 在內的 TGFbeta 家族配體耦合到 CDK 抑制與生長停滯。此誘發是 TGFbeta 驅動旁分泌衰老的主要機制，對受體細胞中的可傳播停滯必要。它是確立的 SMAD 依賴轉錄事件，獲 TGFBR1 抑制劑與剔除研究驗證。

context.en-US: p15INK4b is a key effector of TGF-beta-mediated paracrine senescence; its induction in receiving cells is essential for paracrine growth arrest. By engaging CDK4/6 inhibition, CDKN2B output translates SASP signals into durable cell-cycle exit, making it a downstream execution node of transmissible senescence. The effector relationship is supported by loss-of-function and inhibitor studies showing that blocking p15 induction blunts paracrine arrest. Together with p21CIP1, p15 provides the redundant CDK blockade that locks recruited cells out of the cycle.
context.zh-TW: p15INK4b 是 TGF-beta 介導旁分泌衰老的關鍵效應器；其在受體細胞的誘發對旁分泌生長停滯必要。透過參與 CDK4/6 抑制，CDKN2B 輸出將 SASP 訊號轉化為持久細胞週期退出，使其成為可傳播衰老的下游執行節點。此效應器關係獲顯示阻斷 p15 誘發可減弱旁分泌停滯的功能缺失與抑制劑研究支持。與 p21CIP1 一起，p15 提供將受招募細胞鎖出週期的冗餘 CDK 封鎖。

context.en-US: p15INK4b cooperates with p21CIP1 to enforce G1 arrest during paracrine senescence, combining CDK4/6 inhibition with CDK2 inhibition for robust, redundant blockade. This cooperativity ensures that receiving cells are durably locked out of the cell cycle despite mitogenic signals from the local environment. The synergy between INK4 and CIP/KIP inhibitors is a recurring theme in senescence enforcement, and it strengthens the arrest against escape. Both proteins are induced by TGFbeta-family signaling, ensuring their coordinated expression in recruited cells.
context.zh-TW: p15INK4b 與 p21CIP1 協作在旁分泌衰老期間強制 G1 停滯，結合 CDK4/6 抑制與 CDK2 抑制以達強健、冗餘封鎖。此協作確保受體細胞儘管來自局部環境的促有絲分裂訊號仍被持久鎖出細胞週期。INK4 與 CIP/KIP 抑制因子的協同是衰老執行中反覆出現的主題，並強化停滯以抗逃逸。兩蛋白皆由 TGFbeta 家族訊號誘發，確保其在受招募細胞的協調表現。

context.en-US: CDKN2B is frequently silenced by promoter methylation in leukaemias, lymphomas, and gliomas, abolishing p15INK4b expression and removing a brake on CDK4/6. This epigenetic inactivation contributes to uncontrolled proliferation in cancer and is often assessed as a prognostic marker in myeloid malignancies. The silencing contrasts with its inducible activation during senescence, highlighting the context-dependent regulation of the locus. Demethylating agents such as decitabine and 5-azacytidine can re-express silenced CDKN2B and restore growth arrest, supporting the locus as a therapeutic target.
context.zh-TW: CDKN2B 在白血病、淋巴瘤與神經膠質瘤中常被啟動子甲基化靜默，廢除 p15INK4b 表現並移除對 CDK4/6 的煞車。此表觀遺傳失活貢獻癌症中不受控的增殖，且常作為骨髓性惡性腫瘤的預後標記評估。此靜默不同於其在衰老期間可誘發的活化，凸顯此基因座依脈絡的調節。去甲基化藥劑如 decitabine 與 5-azacytidine 可重新表現靜默的 CDKN2B 並恢復生長停滯，支持此基因座作為治療標靶。

context.en-US: HLA-E is a non-classical (class Ib) major histocompatibility complex molecule with limited polymorphism, presenting a restricted set of peptides, often leader peptides derived from other MHC class I molecules, to innate lymphoid receptors. Its classification distinguishes it from classical MHC class Ia molecules and underpins its specialized ligand-receptor interactions with NKG2A/CD94. In senescence, HLA-E upregulation becomes a mechanism of immune evasion that protects arrested cells from cytotoxic lymphocytes. The class Ib identity enables the checkpoint-like function central to its role in senescence surveillance.
context.zh-TW: HLA-E 是一種低多態性的非典型（class Ib）主要組織相容性複合體分子，呈現一組受限的肽，常為來自其他 MHC class I 分子的導肽，給先天淋巴受體。其分類區分它與典型 MHC class Ia 分子，並支撐其與 NKG2A/CD94 的特化配體—受體交互作用。在衰老中，HLA-E 上升成為保護停滯細胞對抗細胞毒性淋巴球的免疫逃脫機制。此 class Ib 身分啟用對其在衰老監視中角色至為核心的檢查點樣功能。

context.en-US: HLA-E is the ligand for the inhibitory receptor NKG2A/CD94 heterodimer expressed on NK cells and CD8+ T cells. This binding delivers a cognate inhibitory signal upon engagement, dampening the cytotoxic activity of the receptor-bearing lymphocyte. The interaction is a canonical innate immune checkpoint, analogous to PD-1/PD-L1 but restricted to the NKG2A-CD94 axis. In senescence, HLA-E-NKG2A engagement becomes a route by which arrested cells dampen their own immune clearance, contributing to their persistence.
context.zh-TW: HLA-E 是表達於 NK 細胞與 CD8+ T 細胞的抑制性受體 NKG2A/CD94 異二聚體的配體。此結合在參與時傳遞同源抑制訊號，減弱攜帶受體的淋巴球的細胞毒性活性。此交互作用是典型的先天免疫檢查點，類似 PD-1/PD-L1 但限於 NKG2A-CD94 軸。在衰老中，HLA-E-NKG2A 參與成為停滯細胞減弱其自身免疫清除的途徑，貢獻其持續。

context.en-US: HLA-E-NKG2A/CD94 engagement delivers an inhibitory signal that blunts NK cell cytotoxic killing of HLA-E-expressing senescent and tumor cells. By engaging this checkpoint, senescent cells protect themselves from NKG2A-positive NK cells, undermining the innate arm of senescence surveillance. This immune-evasive upregulation reduces the probability of immune clearance and allows arrested cells to persist in tissues. The suppression is a direct ligand-receptor inhibitory mechanism, and blocking the interaction with anti-NKG2A antibodies can restore NK-mediated killing.
context.zh-TW: HLA-E-NKG2A/CD94 參與傳遞抑制訊號，減弱 NK 細胞對表達 HLA-E 的衰老與腫瘤細胞的細胞毒性殺死。透過參與此檢查點，衰老細胞保護自己對抗 NKG2A 陽性 NK 細胞，破壞衰老監視的先天臂。此免疫逃脫性上升減少免疫清除的機率，並允許停滯細胞在組織中持續。此抑制是直接配體—受體抑制機制，且以抗 NKG2A 抗體阻斷此交互作用可恢復 NK 介導的殺死。

context.en-US: HLA-E-NKG2A/CD94 engagement on CD8+ T cells suppresses their cytotoxic killing, extending the immune-evasive effect beyond NK cells to the adaptive compartment. This allows HLA-E-upregulated senescent and malignant cells to evade cytotoxic T lymphocytes, contributing to failed clearance and persistence. The suppression reinforces the dual innate and adaptive immune evasion conferred by HLA-E and mirrors the checkpoint biology exploited by tumors. Pharmacological blockade of the interaction is being explored as a strategy to restore CD8+ T-cell responses.
context.zh-TW: HLA-E-NKG2A/CD94 在 CD8+ T 細胞上的參與抑制其細胞毒性殺死，將免疫逃脫效應從 NK 細胞擴展到適應區室。這允許 HLA-E 上升的衰老與惡性細胞逃避免疫毒性 T 淋巴球，貢獻失敗清除與持續。此抑制強化 HLA-E 賦予的雙重先天與適應免疫逃脫，並反映腫瘤利用的檢查點生物學。藥理阻斷此交互作用正被探索作為恢復 CD8+ T 細胞反應的策略。

context.en-US: SASP cytokines IL-6 and IL-8 upregulate HLA-E, engaging NKG2A/CD94 to suppress NK- and CD8+ T-cell-mediated cytotoxicity against senescent cells. This creates a self-reinforcing loop in which the SASP both recruits immune cells and then protects senescent cells from immune elimination, subverting the very surveillance the SASP initiates. The upregulation of an inhibitory ligand by pro-inflammatory cytokines is a striking example of inflammatory immune evasion and is a key mechanism of senescent-cell persistence. Targeting this axis may restore clearance of persistent senescent cells.
context.zh-TW: SASP 細胞激素 IL-6 與 IL-8 上調 HLA-E，參與 NKG2A/CD94 以抑制對衰老細胞的 NK 與 CD8+ T 細胞介導的細胞毒性。這創造一種自我強化迴圈，其中 SASP 既招募免疫細胞又保護衰老細胞免於免疫排除，顛覆 SASP 啟動的監視本身。促發炎細胞激素上調抑制性配體是發炎免疫逃脫的顯著例子，也是衰老細胞持續的關鍵機制。標靶此軸可能恢復對持續衰老細胞的清除。

context.en-US: HLA-E upregulation mediates immune evasion, allowing senescent cells and tumor cells to escape NK- and CD8+ T-cell-mediated clearance via NKG2A/CD94 engagement. By dampening cytotoxic responses, it converts an otherwise visible arrested cell into a protected one, explaining why some senescent cells persist despite an inflammatory milieu. This immune-evasive function is a recognized senescence-surveillance subversion mechanism and mirrors the HLA-E-driven checkpoint exploited by many tumors. Blocking NKG2A can restore immune-mediated elimination of HLA-E-expressing cells.
context.zh-TW: HLA-E 上升介導免疫逃脫，允許衰老細胞與腫瘤細胞經由 NKG2A/CD94 參與逃避免疫 NK 與 CD8+ T 細胞介導的清除。透過減弱細胞毒性反應，它將否則可見的停滯細胞轉化為受保護的細胞，解釋為何某些衰老細胞儘管有發炎微環境仍持續。此免疫逃脫功能是公認的衰老監視顛覆機制，並反映許多腫瘤利用的 HLA-E 驅動檢查點。阻斷 NKG2A 可恢復對表達 HLA-E 細胞的免疫介導排除。

context.en-US: By dampening immune surveillance through NKG2A/CD94 engagement, HLA-E upregulation allows senescent cells to persist and accumulate rather than be cleared. This impairs the fail-safe tumor-suppression and tissue-homeostasis functions of senescence surveillance and contributes to the chronic inflammatory burden of accumulated senescent cells. The impairment is a direct consequence of SASP-induced HLA-E expression and illustrates a paradoxical self-protective output of the senescence program. Interfering with the HLA-E/NKG2A interaction is a candidate strategy to restore clearance.
context.zh-TW: 透過 NKG2A/CD94 參與減弱免疫監視，HLA-E 上升允許衰老細胞持續與累積而非被清除。這損害衰老監視的失效安全腫瘤抑制與組織恆定功能，並貢獻累積衰老細胞的慢性發炎負擔。此損害是 SASP 誘發 HLA-E 表現的直接後果，並說明衰老程序矛盾的自我保護輸出。干擾 HLA-E/NKG2A 交互作用是以恢復清除為目標的候選策略。

context.en-US: Inflammasomes are cytosolic supramolecular complexes of the innate immune system that assemble in response to pathogens or sterile danger signals to activate inflammatory caspases. They are not antibodies (immune complexes) but rather multiprotein scaffolds; the original classification here as an immune complex is loose, though inflammasomes are innate immune signaling platforms. They serve as a key intersection between senescence, DAMPs, and inflammation. Their activation links cellular damage to IL-1 family cytokine release.
context.zh-TW: 發炎體是先天免疫系統的胞質超分子複合體，組裝以回應病原體或無菌危險訊號，活化發炎性 caspase。它們不是抗體（免疫複合體）而是多重蛋白支架；此處歸類為免疫複合體鬆散，儘管發炎體是先天免疫訊號平台。它們作為衰老、DAMP 與發炎間的關鍵交會點。其活化將細胞損傷連結到 IL-1 家族細胞激素釋放。

context.en-US: Canonical inflammasomes activate caspase-1, which processes pro-IL-1beta and pro-IL-18 into their mature secreted forms and cleaves gasdermin D to execute pyroptosis. This activation is the central effector step of the inflammasome pathway and requires assembly of sensor, ASC, and procaspase-1. In senescence, caspase-1 activity also feeds the SASP, particularly during oncogene-induced senescence where the canonical inflammasome is engaged. The relationship is a foundational inflammasome mechanism with direct relevance to senescence-associated inflammation and sterile immunity.
context.zh-TW: 典型發炎體活化 caspase-1，caspase-1 將 pro-IL-1beta 與 pro-IL-18 切割為成熟、分泌形式，驅動發炎。此切割是衰老細胞中促發炎性 IL-1beta 釋放的核心步驟，且構成 SASP 的 IL-1 臂。不同於 IL-1alpha（細胞內並經 calpain 切割），IL-1beta 嚴格依賴 caspase-1 活化，使發炎體成為 SASP 中此細胞激素的必要閘門。此活化連結 DAMP 感知到分泌組的發炎輸出。

context.en-US: Caspase-1 processes pro-IL-1beta into mature IL-1beta for secretion, providing a major inflammatory cytokine output of inflammasome activation. In senescent contexts, this contributes to the IL-1 family arm of the SASP, particularly in macrophages recruited to senescent tissue. The processing is essential for extracellular IL-1beta bioactivity and links sterile damage signals in senescence to classical inflammatory cytokine release. NLRP3 priming and activation precede the cleavage, ensuring that mature IL-1beta is only produced upon coordinated signaling.
context.zh-TW: 發炎體經由活化的 caspase-1 處理 pro-IL-1beta，產生成熟 IL-1beta 以供分泌，強化發炎性 SASP。此處理使衰老細胞能釋放強效促發炎細胞激素，且與 IL-1alpha 的頂層放大器角色協調放大分泌組。透過提供成熟 IL-1beta，發炎體將 DAMP 感知（如 mtDNA）連結到旁分泌衰老與免疫招募。此過程是衰老細胞釋放功能性 IL-1beta 的確立機制。

context.en-US: Caspase-1/4/5/11 cleave gasdermin D; the N-terminal fragment oligomerizes to form pores in the plasma membrane, causing pyroptosis, an inflammatory lytic cell death. While senescent cells generally resist death, inflammasome-driven pyroptosis can occur in neighboring cells or under certain stimuli, releasing IL-1alpha, HMGB1, and mtDNA into the extracellular space. The relationship connects senescence-associated DAMPs to a distinct cell-death modality and broadens the cell-fate consequences of inflammasome activation. Pyroptotic debris further amplifies the local inflammatory response, creating a feed-forward loop.
context.zh-TW: 發炎體活化觸發 pyroptosis，一種促發炎的炎性細胞死亡，其裂解 gasdermin D 形成膜孔洞並釋放細胞內含物。在衰老中，發炎體驅動的 pyroptosis 可在次致死設定下發生，釋放 DAMPs 與 IL-1 家族細胞激素而不完全殺死細胞，放大 SASP。此過程將細胞死亡形態與分泌表型耦合，並可影響衰老細胞存留與免疫清除。其角色在衰老中仍被積極研究，信度中等。

context.en-US: Chronic inflammasome activation by sterile stimuli, including senescent-cell DAMPs, drives persistent inflammation and age-related diseases, contributing to inflammaging. By producing IL-1beta and IL-18 and sustaining innate immune activation, inflammasomes maintain the low-grade inflammatory milieu characteristic of aging tissues. The relationship positions the inflammasome as a downstream executor of SASP-driven inflammation and links cellular senescence to systemic inflammatory states. It is a well-supported component of the aging inflammatory circuit, with NLRP3 recognized as a major contributor.
context.zh-TW: 發炎體貢獻 inflammaging，透過持續產生 IL-1beta 與釋放 DAMPs 維持慢性低程度發炎。隨年齡累積的發炎體活化源自衰老細胞與組織損傷，產生有助於年齡相關疾病特徵的無菌發炎環境。此貢獻將細胞衰老連結到全身 inflammaging，且 senomorphic 或抗發炎體策略可減輕其效應。它是 SASP—發炎體—aging 軸中的關鍵節點。

context.en-US: Senescent cells accumulate DAMPs such as HMGB1, mtDNA, and oxidized lipids that activate the NLRP3 inflammasome in neighbouring macrophages and possibly within senescent cells themselves. mtDNA, as a potent innate immune stimulus, is a key ligand driving this activation, alongside mitochondrial dysfunction-associated signals. The relationship links the mitochondrial dysfunction of senescence to inflammasome-dependent inflammation and provides a mechanism for SASP-to-inflammasome crosstalk. Cytosolic mtDNA can also engage cGAS-STING, coupling two major innate sensing pathways in senescent tissue.
context.zh-TW: 發炎體被釋放至胞質的 mtDNA 活化，mtDNA 作為損傷相關分子模式接合 NLRP3 等模式識別受體。此活化將粒線體功能障礙（SAMD）與發炎體組裝直接連結，產生 SASP 的 IL-1beta 臂。在衰老細胞中，mtDNA 週期性釋放維持發炎體張力，將代謝壓力轉化為發炎輸出。此機制是粒線體 DAMP 與先天免疫間的核心橋樑。

context.en-US: Canonical inflammasome activation drives the SASP: caspase-1 or IL-1R inhibitors blunt SASP expression, placing inflammasome activation upstream of the secretome during oncogene-induced senescence. By generating mature IL-1beta and amplifying NF-kB signaling, the inflammasome sustains SASP factor production. The relationship establishes the inflammasome as an intrinsic SASP regulator, not merely a responder, and is supported by pharmacological inhibition studies. This positions the canonical pathway as an amplifier of inflammation downstream of senescent-cell stress signals.
context.zh-TW: 發炎體驅動 SASP，特別是透過產生並釋放成熟 IL-1beta，其隨後可放大下游 SASP 因子。此驅動將發炎體置於分泌組的 IL-1 臂上游，並與胞質 DNA 與 mtDNA 感受器協調。透過提供頂層發炎細胞激素，發炎體強化旁分泌衰老與免疫招募。其貢獻使發炎體成為 SASP 調節與 senomorphic 標靶的關鍵組成。

context.en-US: Senescent cells activate the noncanonical inflammasome (caspase-5/11), which cleaves IL-1alpha and drives SASP establishment. This provides a caspase-5-dependent route to the secretome that is distinct from the canonical NLRP3/caspase-1 pathway, and it is increasingly recognized as a core SASP licensing mechanism. The activation links cytosolic sensing to senescence inflammation, and in senescent cells it specifically processes IL-1alpha rather than IL-1beta. Caspase-5 knockdown reduces IL-1alpha release and downstream SASP factors without affecting growth arrest.
context.zh-TW: 衰老細胞活化非典型發炎體，透過 caspase-4/5（人類）或 caspase-11（小鼠）感知胞質 LPS 或直接粒線體訊號，貢獻 IL-1beta 釋放。此非典型途徑補充典型 NLRP3 發炎體，並可能在慢性衰老發炎中被粒線體損傷與 DAMP 放大。其參與擴展衰老細胞中的發炎體景觀，且與典型途徑協作驅動 SASP。此機制較新，信度中等。

context.en-US: Macrophages recruited to senescent cells encounter DAMPs such as mtDNA, HMGB1, and oxidized lipids that activate the canonical NLRP3/caspase-1 inflammasome, producing IL-1beta and amplifying inflammation. This positions macrophages as both effectors of clearance and amplifiers of senescence-associated inflammation, creating a dual axis with the noncanonical inflammasome active in senescent cells themselves. The relationship bridges senescent-cell distress signals to innate immune activation and is a key node in SASP-inflammaging crosstalk. Macrophage inflammasome activation thus amplifies the inflammatory consequences of senescent cell accumulation.
context.zh-TW: 巨噬細胞活化發炎體以回應來自衰老細胞的 DAMPs 與 SASP 因子，創造清除衰老細胞的正向迴圈但也可能加深組織發炎。透過 NLRP3 與其他發炎體感受 DAMP，巨噬細胞產生 IL-1beta 並可採取促發炎極化。此活化將先天免疫效應器連結到衰老相關發炎，且若失調可促成 chronic inflammaging。它是巨噬細胞—衰老細胞交互作用的關鍵機制。

context.en-US: Autophagy suppresses the inflammasome by clearing damaged mitochondria and inflammasome components such as NLRP3, restraining activation and subsequent IL-1beta release. In senescence, impaired autophagy permits inflammasome hyperactivation and sustained inflammation, linking mitochondrial quality control to innate immune output. This makes autophagy a negative regulator of the senescence-inflammatory circuit, and enhancing autophagic flux with agents such as rapamycin dampens inflammasome-driven SASP. The relationship is central to understanding how mitochondrial dysfunction translates into chronic inflammation.
context.zh-TW: 自噬透過清除受損粒線體與抑制 NLRP3 發炎體組裝，抑制發炎體活化。此抑制減少 IL-1beta 產生與 DAMP 釋放，減弱餵養 SASP 與 inflammaging 的發炎迴圈。透過恢復自噬流（如以 rapamycin），可下調發炎體張力，將自噬定位為發炎體的負調節者。此關係對細胞衰老中粒線體品質控制與發炎間的連結至為核心。

context.en-US: MyD88 is a cytoplasmic adaptor protein serving as the central hub of Toll-like receptor (TLR) and IL-1R signaling, linking receptor engagement to downstream kinase cascades. Its classification as an adaptor reflects its role in assembling signaling complexes rather than performing enzymatic catalysis, and it does so through death domain and TIR domain interactions. In senescence, MyD88 transduces IL-1alpha signals that sustain the SASP, placing it at the interface of innate immunity and senescence. It is a foundational innate immune signaling scaffold conserved across species.
context.zh-TW: MyD88 是一種銜接蛋白（adaptor protein），將先天免疫受體如 IL-1R 與 TLR 的胞質訊號域連結到下游 IRAK 激酶與 TRAF6。作為 Toll/IL-1R（TIR）訊號的主要轉接器，其歸類為銜接蛋白反映其在組裝訊號複合體中的支架角色。在衰老中，MyD88 是將 IL-1alpha 頂層放大器連結到 NF-κB 與 SASP 的核心節點。其銜接功能使其成為衰老發炎級聯的中央中樞。

context.en-US: IL-1R recruits MyD88 via TIR-TIR interactions, and MyD88 assembles the myddosome to propagate IL-1alpha/IL-1beta signals in senescent cells and responding macrophages. This transduction is essential for the NF-kB activation that drives SASP and paracrine arrest, and it requires the death-domain-mediated recruitment of IRAK kinases. The relationship positions MyD88 as the immediate downstream effector of IL-1R and is a canonical IL-1R signaling mechanism. Blocking this interaction can suppress IL-1-dependent inflammatory output.
context.zh-TW: MyD88 從 IL-1R 轉導訊號，在 IL-1alpha 或 IL-1beta 接合受體後招募 IRAK4 與 IRAK1 以活化 NF-κB。此轉導是 IL-1 介導旁分泌衰老與 SASP 放大所必需的，且連結頂層 SASP 放大器到下游轉錄。透過 MyD88 缺失阻斷此路徑可抑制衰老擴散，確認其在衰老溝通中的功能必要。它是 IL-1R 訊號至核心發炎輸出的確立橋樑。

context.en-US: MyD88 recruits IRAK4 via death-domain interactions, the first step in myddosome assembly after receptor engagement. IRAK4 then phosphorylates IRAK1/IRAK2, propagating the signal toward TRAF6 and TAK1 activation. This recruitment is a conserved early event in TLR/IL-1R pathways and is essential for downstream NF-kB and AP-1 signaling. In senescence it initiates the cascade that licenses SASP transcription, making IRAK4 a potential target for dampening IL-1-driven inflammation and the myddosome architecture ensures rapid, robust signal propagation.
context.zh-TW: MyD88 招募 IRAK4，IRAK4 是組裝 Myddosome 與啟動 IL-1R/TLR 下游 NF-κB 活化所必需的絲胺酸/蘇胺酸激酶。此招募將受體訊號連結到 IRAK 級聯，並將 MyD88 置於衰老細胞 SASP 轉錄的促發炎訊號樞紐。作為 Myddosome 的組成，IRAK4 對 MyD88 依賴的發炎至為核心，且是潛在的藥理標靶以減弱衰老相關發炎。

context.en-US: Active IRAK4 phosphorylates IRAK1, which then recruits TRAF6 through its C-terminal TRAF6-binding motifs, extending the myddosome signaling complex. This step connects the receptor-proximal kinases to E3 ubiquitin ligase activity and TAK1 activation, ultimately driving NF-kB and MAPK signaling. In senescence, IRAK1 is required for full SASP establishment, linking the IL-1R pathway to the secretome. The relationship is a standard component of IL-1R/TLR signal propagation and is well validated biochemically.
context.zh-TW: MyD88 招募 IRAK1，其與 IRAK4 協作磷酸化並活化 TRAF6 以傳播 NF-κB 與 MAPK 訊號。此步驟在 Myddosome 內組裝下游發炎級聯，將 IL-1R 感知連結到 SASP 基因轉錄。IRAK1 參與使其成為 MyD88 依賴衰老發炎中的功能性節點，且其在旁分泌衰老中的角色支持 MyD88—IRAK—TRAF6 軸的因果貢獻。它是慢性 SASP 輸出維持的組成。

context.en-US: MyD88 assembles into the helical oligomeric myddosome with IRAK4 and IRAK1/2, serving as the scaffolding platform that activates downstream kinases such as TAK1 and transcription factors such as NF-kB. This supramolecular complex is the mechanistic core of IL-1R/TLR signaling and is assembled through death-domain homotypic interactions. In senescence, myddosome formation underlies IL-1alpha-driven SASP, translating IL-1 receptor engagement into inflammatory transcription. The assembly is a defining structural feature of MyD88-dependent signaling and a validated drug target.
context.zh-TW: MyD88 與 IRAK4、IRAK1 及 TRAF6 組裝成稱為 Myddosome 的高階寡聚複合體，作為 IL-1R 與 TLR 下游訊號傳遞的平台。此支架將受體接合轉化為 NF-κB 與 MAPK 活化，驅動 SASP。Myddosome 形成整合 MyD88 的銜接功能與激酶級聯，使其成為衰老發炎輸出的分子引擎。其組裝是連結 IL-1alpha 頂層放大器到分泌組的關鍵步驟。

context.en-US: Senescent-cell surface IL-1alpha engages IL-1R on macrophages, recruiting MyD88 to activate NF-kB and amplify SASP both in the sender cell through autocrine signaling and in recruited immune cells through paracrine signaling. This bridges the senescent cell and the macrophage through IL-1R/MyD88 signaling, propagating inflammation across the tissue. The relationship situates MyD88 at the interface of senescence and innate immunity and explains how local senescence ignites broader inflammatory responses. It is a key mechanism of SASP-driven immune amplification.
context.zh-TW: MyD88 橋接衰老細胞與巨噬細胞，使巨噬細胞中的 IL-1R 訊號感知源自衰老細胞的 IL-1alpha 並引發其對衰老細胞的發炎反應。此橋接將分泌組連結到免疫效應器，促進清除但也發炎，並使 MyD88 成為衰老—巨噬細胞交互作用的關鍵介體。透過將 SASP 轉化為巨噬細胞活化，MyD88 同時支持監視與潜在的 chronic inflammaging。其必要角色在 MyD88 缺失模型中顯示。

context.en-US: MyD88-dependent IL-1R signaling is required for SASP establishment and maintenance; depletion of IRAK1 or MyD88 suppresses SASP factor expression. This places MyD88 as a non-redundant node in the IL-1alpha-to-NF-kB axis that licenses the secretome. The requirement indicates that autocrine and paracrine IL-1 signaling is not incidental but essential for full SASP output, and it is supported by genetic loss-of-function studies in senescence models. Targeting MyD88 or downstream kinases is therefore a plausible strategy to suppress the SASP.
context.zh-TW: MyD88 對 SASP 為必要，因 IL-1alpha 介導的衰老擴散與 SASP 放大依賴 MyD88 依賴的 NF-κB 活化。缺乏 MyD88 的細胞顯示減弱的分泌組與受損的旁分泌衰老傳播，確認其在發炎細胞激素輸出中的功能必要。此必要性將 MyD88 置於 IL-1 中心迴圈的關鍵位置，並使其成為 senomorphic 標靶。它是連結頂層 SASP 放大器到下游轉錄的已確立樞紐。

context.en-US: Persistent MyD88-dependent IL-1R signaling drives age-related chronic inflammation by sustaining NF-kB activation and SASP/cytokine production. As a hub of IL-1 family signaling, MyD88 propagates the inflammatory loop that characterizes inflammaging and links cellular senescence to systemic, sterile inflammation. Because IL-1 signaling through MyD88 operates in both senescent cells and responding immune cells, it amplifies inflammatory output across tissues. Inhibiting MyD88 or the IL-1R is therefore a plausible anti-inflammaging strategy.
context.zh-TW: MyD88 驅動 inflammaging，透過維持由衰老細胞 IL-1alpha 與 SASP 因子觸發的慢性先天免疫活化。作為將 DAMP 與細胞激素受體連結到 NF-κB 的中央樞紐，MyD88 持續性活化助長年齡相關無菌發炎。其驅動角色在 MyD88 缺失減輕衰老相關發炎的模型中支持，使其成為針對 inflammaging 的候選治療標靶。它將細胞衰老直接連結到全身性發炎狀態。

context.en-US: Myeloid-derived suppressor cells (MDSCs) are a heterogeneous population of immature myeloid cells with potent immunosuppressive activity, expanded under pathological stress including cancer and chronic inflammation. Their classification reflects an arrested differentiation state rather than a single lineage, with polymorphonuclear and monocytic subsets recognized. In senescence contexts, MDSCs are recruited by SASP factors and blunt anti-tumor and anti-senescence immunity, shifting the immune balance away from clearance. They represent a key immunosuppressive cell type bridging aging, inflammation, and cancer.
context.zh-TW: MDSCs（骨髓源性抑制細胞）是一群異質、未成熟骨髓細胞，在發炎與癌症中擴張並具免疫抑制功能。其歸類為未成熟骨髓細胞將其定位於骨髓生成與免疫調節的交會點，且其在衰老中重要性上升。在衰老脈絡中，MDSC 累積貢獻免疫抑制與監視受損。其未成熟本質使其對發炎細胞激素與趨化因子高度反應，成為衰老相關免疫逃脫的關鍵角色。

context.en-US: MDSCs suppress T-cell responses by depleting L-arginine via arginase-1, producing ROS and peroxynitrite that impair T-cell receptor signalling, and secreting immunosuppressive cytokines. This broadly dampens adaptive immunity in the tumor and aged microenvironments and can induce regulatory T cells. In senescence, MDSC accumulation weakens T-cell-mediated senescence surveillance, allowing senescent cells to persist and accumulate. The suppression is a well-characterized mechanism of MDSC function and a target for immunotherapy.
context.zh-TW: MDSCs 抑制 T 細胞，透過產生 NO、精胺酸酶與 ROS 消耗 T 細胞存活所需的精胺酸與半胱胺酸並阻斷其增殖。此抑制損害適應性免疫反應，包括針對癌前與衰老細胞的細胞毒性 T 細胞活性。在衰老中，MDSC 擴張削弱 T 細胞介導的衰老監視，並促進免疫逃逸。其抑制功能使其成為腫瘤與衰老相關免疫衰老的關鍵貢獻者。

context.en-US: The SASP factor GM-CSF stimulates myeloid expansion and biases differentiation toward immunosuppressive MDSCs, recruiting them into senescent and tumor tissues. GM-CSF thereby shapes the myeloid compartment to be tolerogenic and arrest-promoting, exemplifying SASP-driven paracrine reprogramming of immune lineage fate. The relationship links a specific SASP cytokine to myeloid suppressor accumulation and is a recognized driver of MDSC expansion in inflammation and cancer. Blocking GM-CSF signaling can reduce MDSC generation.
context.zh-TW: MDSCs 被 GM-CSF 招募，GM-CSF 是一種在發炎與衰老微環境中上調的骨髓生成細胞激素，驅動未成熟抑制性骨髓前驅細胞的擴張與遷移。此招募將 SASP 與組織發炎連結到免疫抑制性骨髓浸潤。透過 GM-CSF，衰老細胞可無意中促成免疫逃逸，因招募的 MDSC 隨後抑制清除衰老細胞所需的 T 細胞。它是衰老相關免疫調節的正向迴圈。

context.en-US: CCL2 recruits CCR2-positive myeloid precursors into senescent and tumour tissue, where they can differentiate into MDSCs under the influence of SASP cytokines. This chemokine-driven trafficking expands the immunosuppressive myeloid pool at sites of senescence and inflammation. The relationship connects the SASP to myeloid suppressor infiltration and reinforces the immune-subverting arm of the senescent secretome. CCR2 antagonists are being explored to block this recruitment and restore immune competence.
context.zh-TW: MDSCs 被 CCL2 招募，CCL2 是衰老細胞 SASP 中的趨化因子，將抑制性骨髓細胞吸引至衰老組織。此招募將分泌組連結到免疫抑制性浸潤，因 CCL2 驅動的 MDSC 蓄積可阻礙對衰老與癌前細胞的 T 細胞清除。透過將 SASP 因子重新導向免疫抑制而非清除，此機制可反轉衰老監視的預期效益。它凸顯 SASP 對免疫景觀影響的雙重性。

context.en-US: IL-6 and other pro-inflammatory SASP cytokines promote MDSC accumulation and activation via JAK/STAT3 signalling, expanding the immunosuppressive myeloid compartment. This creates a feedback loop in which the SASP both recruits and licenses MDSCs, sustaining systemic immune suppression. The relationship links senescent-cell secretion to systemic immune dysfunction and is supported by cancer and aging immunology studies. JAK/STAT3 inhibitors can reduce MDSC expansion, positioning this axis as a therapeutic target.
context.zh-TW: MDSCs 被 IL-6 擴張，IL-6 是強效的 SASP 細胞激素，促進未成熟骨髓前驅細胞的存活與增殖。此擴張在慢性發炎與衰老微環境中放大免疫抑制區室，進一步損害 T 細胞功能與衰老監視。透過 IL-6，持續衰老分泌組無意中助長其自身逃避免疫清除。此關係將 SASP 的發炎臂連結到骨髓生成調節與免疫衰老。

context.en-US: MDSCs impair immune-mediated clearance of senescent cells by suppressing T-cell and NK effector functions and fostering an immunosuppressive milieu, allowing senescent-cell accumulation. This subversion of surveillance permits persistence of arrested cells and their SASP, converting an acute tumor-suppressive response into chronic inflammation. The relationship positions MDSCs as antagonists of senescence surveillance and is a plausible but moderate-confidence link supported by cancer and aging immunology. Restoring effector function in the presence of MDSCs is an active therapeutic goal.
context.zh-TW: MDSCs 損害衰老監視，透過抑制 T 細胞並創造允許衰老與癌前細胞逃避免疫清除的免疫抑制微環境。其擴張隨年齡與發炎（包括 SASP）上升，削弱排除停滯細胞的失效安全機制。此損害貢獻衰老細胞隨年齡的累積，並將 MDSC 定位為監視失敗的關鍵介體。它是免疫逃逸軸中的核心節點，連結 SASP 到監視下行。

context.en-US: Elevated MDSC frequencies rise with age and contribute to immunosenescence by suppressing T-cell and NK responses and promoting a tolerogenic environment. Their expansion is both a marker and a driver of age-related immune decline, and it correlates with chronic inflammation. The relationship embeds MDSCs within the broader aging immune dysfunction and links the SASP to adaptive immune deterioration. Reducing MDSC burden is proposed as a strategy to rejuvenate aged immune responses, and markers of MDSC accumulation are being tested as biomarkers of immune aging.
context.zh-TW: MDSCs 貢獻免疫衰老，透過其免疫抑制功能與擴張加劇年齡相關免疫功能衰退。在衰老中，MDSC 蓄積削弱對感染、疫苗與癌前病變的適應性免疫反應，加劇免疫老化表型。此貢獻與慢性發炎（inflammaging）協作，其中 SASP 驅動的骨髓生成維持抑制性細胞池。將 MDSCs 連結到免疫衰老將其置於老化免疫衰退的核心。

context.en-US: Chronic SASP-driven MDSC expansion contributes to age-related inflammation by altering myeloid homeostasis and sustaining an immunosuppressive yet inflammatory milieu. While MDSCs are classically suppressive, their recruitment by SASP cytokines feeds the chronic activation characteristic of inflammaging. The relationship is part of the complex senescence-immune axis in which suppressive and inflammatory programs coexist. Confidence is moderate given the dual suppressive and pro-inflammatory nature of MDSCs, and further studies are needed to define their net contribution to age-related inflammation.
context.zh-TW: 慢性 SASP 驅動的 MDSC 擴張透過改變骨髓生成稳态並維持免疫抑制卻發炎的微環境，貢獻年齡相關發炎。儘管 MDSC 典型為抑制作用，其被 SASP 細胞激素招募餵養了 inflammaging 特徵的慢性活化。此貢獻將 SASP 連結到骨髓生成失衡，其中免疫抑制與發炎並存，加深年齡相關無菌發炎。它是衰老—免疫—發炎軸中的關鍵節點。

context.en-US: The noncanonical inflammasome is an innate immune surveillance pathway distinct from the canonical NLRP3/caspase-1 pathway, centered on human caspase-4/5 and mouse caspase-11. It is activated directly by cytosolic LPS and amplifies inflammatory signaling, including through gasdermin D pore formation. In senescence, it is a principal SASP-licensing mechanism via IL-1alpha cleavage. Its classification as an inflammasome variant reflects shared gasdermin-mediated outcomes and inflammatory cell death, despite the absence of an upstream sensor protein.
context.zh-TW: 非典型發炎體是一種不同於典型 NLRP3/caspase-1 路徑的先天免疫監視途徑，以人類 caspase-4/5 與小鼠 caspase-11 為中心。它直接被胞質 LPS 活化並放大發炎訊號，包括透過 gasdermin D 孔洞形成。在衰老中，此途徑提供 IL-1alpha 成熟與 SASP 驅動的替代機制，補充典型發炎體。其區分身分使其成為衰老相關發炎的重要調節者。

context.en-US: Caspase-5 (human) is the inducible noncanonical effector caspase that cleaves IL-1alpha and gasdermin D to drive SASP and pyroptosis. Its activation is essential for the noncanonical inflammasome's role in senescence, and its expression is induced by interferons and controlled upstream by the cGAS-STING pathway. The relationship positions caspase-5 as the enzymatic executor of the pathway in human cells. It is supported by cleavage-site and loss-of-function studies showing reduced SASP after CASP5 knockdown.
context.zh-TW: Caspase-5（人類）是可誘發的非典型效應 caspase，切割 IL-1alpha 與 gasdermin D 以驅動 SASP 與 pyroptosis。其活化對非典型發炎體在衰老中的角色必要，且其表現被干擾素誘發並受上游 cGAS-STING 控制。透過產生活性 IL-1alpha，caspase-5 許可 SASP 本身而非僅回應它，將非典型發炎體置於分泌組上游。此切割是連結先天免疫到衰老溝通的關鍵步驟。

context.en-US: Caspase-11 (mouse) is the noncanonical effector caspase that cleaves IL-1alpha and gasdermin D, paralleling human caspase-4/5. It is activated by cytosolic LPS and drives SASP establishment in murine senescence models, and it is required for SASP-driven immune clearance of senescent hepatocytes in vivo. The relationship establishes the species-specific executor of the noncanonical pathway in mice. It is a well-supported component of senescence inflammasome biology, with genetic deficiency of the enzyme blunting IL-1alpha processing and downstream secretome output.
context.zh-TW: Caspase-11（小鼠）是切割 IL-1alpha 與 gasdermin D 的非典型效應 caspase，平行於人類 caspase-4/5。它被胞質 LPS 活化並在小鼠衰老模型中驅動 SASP 建立，且為體內 SASP 驅動的衰老肝細胞免疫清除所需。其在小鼠中與 caspase-5 在人類中的功能對等，使非典型發炎體成為跨物種保守的衰老發炎機制。此切割產生活性 IL-1alpha 與 pyroptotic 孔洞。

context.en-US: Caspase-5 cleaves pro-IL-1alpha at a conserved site distinct from the calpain cleavage site, an event essential for SASP establishment and paracrine signaling. This cleavage converts IL-1alpha into its active form that engages IL-1R on sender and receiver cells, linking the noncanonical inflammasome to the apical SASP amplifier. The relationship places caspase-5 upstream of IL-1-dependent secretome regulation and is a key mechanism coupling the noncanonical inflammasome to senescence inflammation.
context.zh-TW: Caspase-5 在與 calpain 切割位點不同的保守位點切割 pro-IL-1alpha，此事件對 SASP 建立與旁分泌訊號必要。此切割將 IL-1alpha 轉化為其活性形式，接合傳送者與受體細胞上的 IL-1R，將非典型發炎體連結到旁分泌衰老。不同於 caspase-1 處理 IL-1beta，此通路處理 IL-1alpha，擴展發炎體對 SASP 的貢獻。它是 SASP 中 IL-1alpha 成熟的確立機制。

context.en-US: Active caspase-4/5/11 cleave gasdermin D between its N-terminal pore-forming domain and C-terminal inhibitory domain, releasing the N-terminal fragment to form plasma-membrane pores. This drives inflammatory cell death (pyroptosis) and IL-1alpha release in senescent and responding cells, and the pores also permit release of IL-1beta and IL-18 prior to membrane rupture. The relationship is the canonical execution step of noncanonical inflammasome signaling and links the pathway to both cell death and SASP amplification, creating a feed-forward inflammatory loop in senescent tissue.
context.zh-TW: 活化的 caspase-4/5/11 切割 gasdermin D 其 N 端成孔域與 C 端抑制域之間，釋放 N 端片段形成質膜孔洞。這驅動發炎性細胞死亡（pyroptosis）與衰老及反應細胞中的 IL-1alpha 釋放，且孔洞允許 DAMPs 與細胞激素外逸以放大發炎。透過將非典型發炎體連結到膜透化，此切割將細胞死亡形態與 SASP 耦合，影響衰老細胞存留與免疫清除。

context.en-US: Noncanonical inflammasome-mediated IL-1alpha cleavage is a critical upstream trigger for the SASP in senescent cells, providing the active IL-1alpha that sustains NF-kB signaling and secretome production. Caspase-5/11 thus license the secretome rather than merely respond to it, operating independently of the canonical NLRP3/caspase-1 pathway. The relationship establishes the noncanonical pathway as a core SASP initiator and is supported by cleavage-deficiency and inhibitor studies. This makes it a distinct therapeutic target for senescence inflammation.
context.zh-TW: 非典型發炎體介導的 IL-1alpha 切割是衰老細胞中 SASP 的關鍵上游觸發因子，提供維持 NF-kB 訊號與分泌組產生的活性 IL-1alpha。因此 caspase-5/11 許可分泌組而非僅回應它，獨立於典型 caspase-1 路徑運作。此上游角色將非典型發炎體置於 SASP 誘發的因果鏈中，解釋為何阻斷其可減弱分泌組。它是 IL-1alpha 中心發炎迴圈的核心組成。

context.en-US: cGAS-STING controls CASP5 (caspase-5) expression upstream; cGAS knockdown reduces CASP5 levels and thereby noncanonical inflammasome activity, coupling cytosolic DNA sensing to IL-1alpha cleavage and SASP. This positions cGAS-STING as a regulator of the noncanonical pathway in senescence, integrating innate DNA sensing with inflammasome-driven inflammation. The relationship is supported by genetic interference experiments and reveals a hierarchical link between two major inflammatory signaling systems.
context.zh-TW: cGAS-STING 在上游控制 CASP5（caspase-5）表現；cGAS 敲低降低 CASP5 層級從而非典型發炎體活性，將胞質 DNA 感知耦合到 IL-1alpha 切割與 SASP。這將 cGAS-STING 定位為衰老中非典型路徑的調節者，整合先天免疫感知與 IL-1alpha 成熟。其控制角色意味 cGAS-STING 活性的變化會瀑布式影響非典型發炎體與下游分泌組輸出。

context.en-US: Gasdermin D pore formation by the noncanonical inflammasome triggers K+ efflux, which in turn activates the canonical NLRP3/caspase-1 inflammasome downstream. This creates a hierarchical cascade in which noncanonical activation licenses canonical inflammasome firing and amplifies IL-1beta production and inflammation. In senescence, the relationship connects the IL-1alpha-based senescent-cell pathway to the IL-1beta-based macrophage pathway, coordinating the dual inflammasome axis. It is a well-documented cross-talk between the two inflammasome pathways.
context.zh-TW: 非典型發炎體的 gasdermin D 孔洞形成觸發 K+ 外流，繼而下游活化典型 NLRP3/caspase-1 發炎體。這創造層級級聯，其中非典型活化許可典型發炎體點火並放大 IL-1beta 產生，將兩條發炎體途徑連結成單一放大的發炎輸出。在衰老中，此階層使非典型觸發轉化為強健的 IL-1beta 分泌，加強 SASP 的發炎臂。它是發炎體串聯的關鍵機制。

context.en-US: The hexa-acylated lipid A of LPS binds directly to the CARD domain of caspase-4/5/11, inducing their dimerization and activation, the defining trigger of the noncanonical inflammasome. While classically microbial, this mechanism can be engaged in senescence-associated inflammatory contexts. The relationship is the canonical activation mode of the pathway and links Gram-negative sensing to caspase activation. Because the caspases themselves are the sensors, no upstream receptor is required for this pathway.
context.zh-TW: LPS 的六醯化 lipid A 直接結合 caspase-4/5/11 的 CARD 域，誘發其雙聚化與活化，是非典型發炎體的定義性觸發因子。雖典型為微生物性，此機制可在衰老相關發炎脈絡中被啟動。此關係將微生物產物感知連結到內源性發炎，且若胞質 LPS 或 LPS 樣配體在衰老中出現，可能貢獻非典型發炎體活化。它是該途徑的確立啟動機制。

context.en-US: Paracrine reprogramming is the biological process by which SASP factors alter the differentiation status and fate of neighbouring cells, pushing them toward stemness, EMT, or altered lineage commitment. Distinct from paracrine senescence, which induces growth arrest, it remodels recipient identity and is dose- and time-dependent, with acute exposure promoting plasticity and chronic exposure driving fibrosis and cancer stemness. The process is mediated by cytokines such as IL-6, TGFbeta, and VEGF family members. It expands the non-cell-autonomous influence of senescent cells beyond growth arrest.
context.zh-TW: 旁分泌重編程是 SASP 因子改變鄰近細胞分化狀態與命運、將其推向幹性、EMT 或改變譜系承諾的生物學過程。不同於誘發生長停滯的旁分泌衰老，它重塑受體身分而非使其停滯。此過程將衰老分泌組定位為組織重塑的形態發生素來源，且其與旁分泌衰老的並存說明 SASP 具多重非細胞自主性後果。它是衰老相關組織重塑的核心機制。

context.en-US: SASP factors act as paracrine morphogens that push recipient cells toward stemness or altered lineage commitment, exemplifying paracrine reprogramming. This reshapes tissue architecture and can promote cancer stemness or metaplasia in chronic contexts. The relationship positions the SASP as a fate-modulating signal, not merely an inflammatory one, and is supported by studies of chronic SASP exposure in epithelial and stromal cells. Short-term SASP exposure instead supports regeneration by enhancing recipient-cell plasticity.
context.zh-TW: SASP 因子作為旁分泌形態發生素，將受體細胞推向幹性或改變的譜系承諾，例示旁分泌重編程。這重塑組織架構，並在慢性脈絡中可促進癌症幹性與化生。此關係將 SASP 定位為命運調節者而非僅發炎來源，擴展其對組織可塑性的影響。透過改變受體細胞身分，它可貢獻惡性進展與修復，依脈絡而定。

context.en-US: IL-6 is a central driver of in vivo reprogramming toward pluripotency and stemness via JAK/STAT3 signaling, promoting a dedifferentiated, stem-like state in recipient cells. This underlies both wound-healing plasticity and, pathologically, cancer stemness, with STAT3 transcriptionally sustaining stemness factors such as OCT4, NANOG, and SOX2. The relationship links a core SASP cytokine to cell-fate reprogramming and is supported by reprogramming and cancer-stemness studies. Blocking IL-6/JAK/STAT3 signaling can interrupt this reprogramming.
context.zh-TW: IL-6 是透過 JAK/STAT3 訊號驅動體內朝多能性與幹性重編程的核心驅動者，在受體細胞中促進去分化、類幹細胞狀態。這構成傷口癒合可塑性，以及病理上、由 STAT3 轉錄持續幹性基因的癌症幹性。在衰老中，SASP 的 IL-6 可重編程鄰近細胞朝向幹樣身分，有助組織修復但也可能助長腫瘤幹性。它是 SASP—幹性軸的主要效應器。

context.en-US: TGFbeta is a master regulator driving epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition (EMT) in neighbouring cells during chronic SASP exposure, activating SMAD and non-SMAD pathways that downregulate epithelial markers and induce mesenchymal traits. EMT enhances invasiveness and stemness, contributing to fibrosis and metastasis, and is mechanistically intertwined with the acquisition of cancer stem-cell properties. The relationship is a canonical TGFbeta function repurposed in the senescence secretome and is well established in developmental and pathological contexts.
context.zh-TW: TGFbeta 是在慢性 SASP 暴露期間驅動鄰近細胞上皮—間質轉化（EMT）的總調節者，活化 SMAD 與非 SMAD 路徑下調上皮標記並誘發間質特性。EMT 增強侵襲性與幹性，貢獻纖維化與轉移表型。在衰老中，慢性 TGFbeta 暴露將 SASP 連結到組織重塑與惡性進展，是其促纖維化與促腫瘤角色的核心。此驅動是慢性分泌組的關鍵後果。

context.en-US: Chronic SASP, through IL-6 and IL-8 via JAK/STAT3, promotes cancer stem-cell traits and expands the CSC pool in neighbouring epithelial and tumour cells, enhancing tumour initiation and relapse potential. By driving stemness and survival, the persistent secretome fosters malignant progression and therapy resistance. The relationship is a key mechanism by which senescence can become tumor-promoting and is supported by cancer-stemness and senescence co-culture studies. It motivates the one-two punch strategy of senescence induction followed by senolytic clearance.
context.zh-TW: 慢性 SASP 透過 IL-6 與 IL-8 經 JAK/STAT3 促進癌症幹細胞特性，並擴張鄰近上皮與腫瘤細胞中的 CSC 池，增強腫瘤起始與復發潛力。透過驅動幹性與存活，持續分泌組助長惡性進展並削弱治療。此促進將衰老與治療誘發衰老連結到腫瘤幹性，說明 SASP 在慢性脈絡中的雙重、促腫瘤面。它是年齡相關癌症的關鍵機制。

context.en-US: IL-8 signalling through CXCR2 expands the cancer stem cell (CSC) pool and promotes tumoursphere formation, linking a core SASP chemokine to stemness in malignant contexts. This enhances tumour aggressiveness and therapy resistance and drives an invasive, EMT-associated phenotype in breast and colorectal models. The relationship positions IL-8 as a stemness-driving SASP component, and it is supported by CXCR2-blockade and tumoursphere assays. Targeting the IL-8/CXCR2 axis is explored as an anti-stemness strategy.
context.zh-TW: IL-8 透過 CXCR2 的訊號擴張癌症幹細胞（CSC）池並促進腫瘤球形成，將核心 SASP 趨化因子連結到惡性脈絡中的幹性。這增強腫瘤侵襲性與治療抗藥性，並在乳房與大腸癌中驅動具侵襲性、EMT 相關的表型。在衰老中，IL-8 的此作用將分泌組輸出耦合到幹細胞擴張，貢獻 SASP 的促腫瘤潛力。它是幹性—發炎軸的關鍵節點。

context.en-US: Therapy-induced senescent (TIS) cells secrete a pro-stemness SASP through IL-6/JAK/STAT3, enriching cancer stem cells in surrounding cells and fuelling relapse. By imposing a stem-like, therapy-resistant phenotype on neighbours, TIS can undermine the efficacy of cytotoxic treatment, since a fraction of tumour cells spared by chemotherapy enter senescence and paradoxically promote recurrence. The relationship is a key late complication of senescence-inducing therapies, and confidence is moderate but supported by multiple tumor models. Sequential senolytic clearance is proposed to limit this effect.
context.zh-TW: 治療誘發衰老（TIS）細胞透過 IL-6/JAK/STAT3 分泌促幹性 SASP，富集周圍細胞中的癌症幹細胞並助長復發。透過對鄰近細胞施加類幹細胞、治療抗藥性表型，TIS 可破壞細胞毒性治療的療效，因部分細胞獲得幹樣復發潛力。此促進凸顯 TIS 的兩面性：急性腫瘤抑制但慢性幹性驅動。它是化療後復發的關鍵機制。

context.en-US: IL-6, IL-1beta, and TGFbeta together drive naive T-cell differentiation toward the TH17 lineage, linking the SASP to adaptive immune reprogramming. TH17 cells recruited to senescent niches can amplify inflammation and promote autoimmunity-like responses. The relationship connects the secretome to a distinct effector T-cell subset with pro-inflammatory roles and is a well-established cytokine combination in TH17 biology. This illustrates how the SASP shapes not only innate but also adaptive immune responses.
context.zh-TW: IL-6、IL-1beta 與 TGFbeta 共同驅動初始 T 細胞朝 TH17 譜系分化，將 SASP 連結到適應性免疫重編程。被招募至衰老巢的 TH17 細胞可放大發炎並促進類自體免疫反應。此關係將分泌組連結到特定 T 細胞子集偏移，擴展 SASP 超越先天活化的免疫學後果。它是衰老與自體免疫樣發炎間的橋樑。

context.en-US: GM-CSF and CCL2 skew myeloid differentiation toward immunosuppressive MDSCs and specific macrophage phenotypes, reshaping the myeloid compartment in senescence and cancer. This biases haematopoiesis away from inflammatory resolution toward tolerance and suppression, exemplifying SASP-driven paracrine reprogramming of immune lineage fate. The relationship links SASP factors to myeloid lineage outcomes and is supported by myeloid-differentiation and tumor-immunology studies. Targeting these factors can restore protective myeloid responses.
context.zh-TW: GM-CSF 與 CCL2 將骨髓分化偏斜向免疫抑制性 MDSC 與特定巨噬細胞表型，重塑衰老與癌症中的骨髓區室。這將造血偏離發炎解決而朝向耐受與抑制，改變免疫景觀以利腫瘤進展與慢性發炎。在衰老中，此偏斜由 SASP 驅動，貢獻監視受損與免疫逃逸。它是連結分泌組到骨髓生成重塑的關鍵機制。

context.en-US: Paracrine reprogramming alters the differentiation status (stemness, EMT) of recipient cells, whereas paracrine senescence induces growth arrest in them; the two are distinct non-cell-autonomous consequences of the SASP. Both can co-occur, but their endpoints differ: fate change versus cell-cycle exit. The distinction clarifies the multifarious influence of senescent cells on neighbours and matters for interpreting whether SASP exposure is regenerative or pathological. It is a conceptual but important separation within senescence biology.
context.zh-TW: 旁分泌重編程改變受體細胞的分化狀態（幹性、EMT），而旁分泌衰老則誘發其生長停滯；兩者是 SASP 不同的非細胞自主性後果。兩者皆可能共存，但端點相反——一者重塑身分，一者強加停滯。此區別對理解衰老分泌組的多重效應至為核心，並說明相同分泌組如何同時驅動組織重塑與腫瘤抑制。它是 SASP 生物學的關鍵概念分界。

context.en-US: VEGF-C is a member of the VEGF family of cysteine-knot growth factors, structurally related to VEGF-A but with distinct receptor usage and lymphatic specificity. Its classification situates it among the growth-factor arm of the SASP, and in senescence it is an early-induced angiogenic and lymphangiogenic factor. The family membership underpins its receptor interactions, particularly with VEGFR-3 and, after proteolytic processing, VEGFR-2. This dual receptor capacity distinguishes its vascular functions from other family members.
context.zh-TW: VEGF-C 是 VEGF 家族的胱胺酸結（cysteine-knot）生長因子成員，結構上與 VEGF-A 相關但具不同的受體使用與淋巴特異性。其分類將其置於 SASP 的生長因子臂，在衰老中它是連結分泌組到血管與淋巴管生成的因子。其與 VEGF-A 的關係反映 SASP 生長因子的多樣性，且其在促血管生成與淋巴生成間的雙重角色使其獨特。它是分泌組中較少被認識的組成。

context.en-US: VEGF-C signals primarily through VEGFR-3 on lymphatic endothelium, promoting lymphangiogenesis and lymphatic vessel sprouting. This receptor usage distinguishes VEGF-C from VEGF-A's preferential VEGFR2 engagement and underlies its role in lymphatic remodeling around senescent tissue. In the SASP, VEGF-C-VEGFR3 signaling contributes to lymphatic vessel formation and potentially to immune cell trafficking routes. The relationship is a canonical VEGF-C function well established in lymphatic biology.
context.zh-TW: VEGF-C 主要透過淋巴內皮上的 VEGFR-3 訊號，促進淋巴生成與淋巴管出芽。此受體使用區分 VEGF-C 與 VEGF-A 偏好 VEGFR2 接合，並構成其淋巴重塑角色基礎，將 SASP 連結到淋巴血管系統。在衰老中，這可影響免疫細胞遷移路徑與組織液體穩態。它是 VEGF 家族受體特異性如何塑造分泌組血管效應的例證。

context.en-US: At higher concentrations or after proteolytic processing, VEGF-C also engages VEGFR2 on blood vascular endothelium, supporting angiogenesis in addition to its lymphatic actions. This dual receptor usage broadens its angiogenic potential within the SASP and explains how VEGF-C can drive both blood- and lymphatic-vessel formation, depending on the local processing environment. The relationship is supported by receptor-binding and processing studies, and it positions processed VEGF-C as a shared ligand across the two receptor systems with distinct downstream signaling outputs.
context.zh-TW: 在較高濃度或經蛋白水解處理後，VEGF-C 也接合血血管內皮上的 VEGFR2，除淋巴作用外也支持血管生成。此雙重受體使用拓寬其在 SASP 內的血管生成潛力，並擴展其對組織血管化的貢獻。此靈活性意味 VEGF-C 依局部濃度與蛋白水解而橋接淋巴與血血管生成，使其成為分泌組中多功能的血管重塑因子。

context.en-US: VEGF-C is a secreted SASP growth factor induced during RAS-driven oncogene-induced senescence as early as 2-3 days after RAS activation. As a component of the secretome it links senescence to angiogenic and lymphangiogenic signaling, contributing to tissue remodeling around senescent cells. Its early induction marks it among the first SASP factors deployed, and its expression is reinforced by IL-1alpha and NF-kB. The relationship situates VEGF-C within the growth-factor repertoire of senescence.
context.zh-TW: VEGF-C 是在 RAS 驅動的致癌基因誘發衰老期間誘發的、分泌性 SASP 生長因子，早在 RAS 活化後 2–3 天即出現。作為分泌組成分，它將衰老連結到血管生成與淋巴生成訊號，貢獻組織重塑與血管化。其早期誘發標記其為 OIS 的急性反應因子，且其在分泌組中的納入擴展了 SASP 超越純發炎的生長因子臂。它是衰老—血管生成軸的關鍵介體。

context.en-US: VEGF-C contributes to paracrine senescence: VEGFR2/FLT3 inhibition suppressed paracrine arrest, indicating VEGF-family signaling is one branch mediating transmissible growth arrest. This positions VEGF-C among the less obvious SASP factors with arrest-inducing capacity and broadens the mechanistic basis of paracrine senescence beyond classical cytokines. The relationship is supported by inhibitor studies showing reduced paracrine arrest upon VEGFR blockade. Confidence is moderate, as the VEGF branch is one of several cooperating signals.
context.zh-TW: VEGF-C 貢獻旁分泌衰老：VEGFR2/FLT3 抑制抑制了旁分泌停滯，顯示 VEGF 家族訊號是介導可傳播生長停滯的一分支。這將 VEGF-C 定位於具停滯誘發能力的、較不顯眼的 SASP 因子之一，補充 TGFbeta 與 Activin A 的停滯臂。其角色例示 SASP 如何透過多種獨立配體驅動旁分泌衰老，確保強健的生長抑制擴散。

context.en-US: VEGF-C expression is induced downstream of RAS/RAF/MEK oncogenic signalling and reinforced by IL-1alpha and NF-kB during senescence. This couples oncogene activation to early angiogenic factor output in the SASP, with induction detectable as early as 2-3 days after RAS activation. The relationship embeds VEGF-C within the oncogene-induced senescence signaling cascade and is supported by RAS-driven senescence time-course studies. It exemplifies how oncogenic stress directly licenses growth-factor secretion.
context.zh-TW: VEGF-C 表現受 RAS/RAF/MEK 致癌訊號下游誘發，並在衰老期間被 IL-1alpha 與 NF-kB 強化。這將致癌基因活化耦合到 SASP 中早期血管生成因子輸出，且誘發早在 RAS 活化後 2–3 天即可檢測。其調節將上游致癌訊號與發炎轉錄因子連結到血管生成分支，使 VEGF-C 成為 OIS 早期反應的一部分。它是連結致癌壓力到分泌組血管效應的關鍵節點。

context.en-US: Processed VEGF-C engages VEGFR2 to support blood-vessel angiogenesis, contributing to the angiogenic arm of the SASP. This promotes vascularization in wound healing but also in tumor and chronic-inflammatory contexts. The relationship links a senescence-secreted growth factor to new vessel formation and explains the pro-angiogenic influence of the secretome on surrounding tissue. It is a well-characterized VEGF-C activity that complements its primary lymphangiogenic role, and it may support nutrient supply and inflammatory cell trafficking into senescent tissue.
context.zh-TW: 經處理的 VEGF-C 接合 VEGFR2 以支持血管生成，貢獻 SASP 的血管生成臂。這在傷口癒合中促進血管化，但也在腫瘤與慢性炎症脈絡中。此關係將衰老分泌的生長因子連結到新血管形成，擴展分泌組超越免疫調節的功能後果。在慢性脈絡中，其血管生成可支持腫瘤生長，說明 SASP 的雙重性。它是分泌組生長因子臂的典型組成。

context.en-US: Full-length VEGF-C preferentially activates VEGFR-3 and promotes lymphatic vessel sprouting, driving lymphangiogenesis. In senescence, this contributes to lymphatic remodeling and potentially to immune cell trafficking routes, shaping how immune cells access senescent tissue. The relationship is the canonical lymphangiogenic function of VEGF-C and expands the vascular consequences of the SASP beyond blood vessels. It is supported by studies of lymphatic development and tumor-associated lymphangiogenesis.
context.zh-TW: 全長 VEGF-C 偏好活化 VEGFR-3 並促進淋巴管出芽，驅動淋巴生成。在衰老中，這貢獻淋巴重塑並可能影響免疫細胞遷移路徑，塑造免疫細胞如何接近衰老灶。其淋巴特異性角色補充 VEGF-A 的血血管生成，使 SASP 的血管效應具雙重性。它是連結細胞衰老到淋巴系統重塑的關鍵因子。

context.en-US: Activated RAS (e.g., HRASG12V) is a prototypical OIS-inducing oncogene, driving hyperproliferation and replication stress that triggers senescence as a tumor-suppressive failsafe. RAS signaling pushes cells into S-phase at excessive frequency, generating DNA damage that stabilizes p53 and derepresses p16, enforcing durable arrest. The relationship is a foundational model of OIS, first described by Serrano in 1997, and is extensively validated across cell and animal systems. It underlies the concept of oncogene-induced tumor-suppressive barriers.
context.zh-TW: 活化的 RAS（如 HRASG12V）是典型 OIS 誘發致癌基因，驅動過度增殖與複製壓力，觸發衰老作為腫瘤抑制失效安全。RAS 訊號以過高頻率將細胞推入 S 期，產生 DNA 損傷並激活 DDR 以強制停滯。此誘發是致癌基因誘發衰老的原型，並將癌基因活化直接耦合到生長停止。它是理解 OIS 作為腫瘤抑制屏障的基礎。

context.en-US: Constitutively active BRAF V600E induces OIS in melanocytes and is the hallmark of benign melanocytic nevi, where senescence arrests the proliferative potential of mutated cells. The MAPK hyperactivation drives replication stress and the DNA-damage response, engaging the senescence program and forming prominent SAHF. The relationship is a classic example of oncogene-induced arrest in a human lesion and is well supported clinically and experimentally. It demonstrates that senescence serves as an in vivo barrier against melanoma.
context.zh-TW: 組成型活化 BRAF V600E 在黑色素細胞中誘發 OIS，是良性黑色素細胞痣的特徵，其中衰老封鎖突變細胞的增殖潛力。MAPK 過度活化驅動複製壓力與 DNA 損傷反應，最終導致停滯。此誘發例示 OIS 如何在體內隔離癌前細胞，且痣是衰老作為癌症屏障的人類例證。它是致癌基因誘發腫瘤抑制的經典模型。

context.en-US: Oncogenic MYC overdrives proliferative and E2F programs that trigger OIS, as excessive mitogenic signaling exhausts replicative capacity and engages senescence checkpoints. MYC-induced senescence is a recognized tumor-suppressive response in multiple tissues, arising from hyper-replication and DNA damage. The relationship positions MYC among canonical OIS inducers alongside RAS and BRAF and is supported by transgenic and overexpression models. It highlights that even growth-promoting oncogenes can activate the senescence barrier.
context.zh-TW: 致癌基因 MYC 過度驅動增殖與 E2F 程序，觸發 OIS，因過度的促有絲分裂訊號耗盡複製能力並啟動衰老檢查點。MYC 誘發的衰老是多種組織中公認的腫瘤抑制反應，將致癌壓力轉化為生長停止。此誘發凸顯 OIS 如何由不同致癌基因透過共享的複製壓力機制觸發。它是細胞防禦惡性轉化的關鍵機制。

subject: RAS

context.en-US: Constitutive oncogenic RAS signaling pushes cells into hyper-replication, where DNA replication forks are initiated at excessive frequency and become stalled or collapsed. This generates single-stranded DNA gaps and replication stress that activate checkpoint kinases ATR and ATM, converging on p53 stabilization. The relationship is a central mechanism linking oncogene activation to senescence-inducing damage and is well established in OIS biology. It explains how proliferative overload is converted into a senescence signal.
context.zh-TW: 組成型致癌 RAS 訊號將細胞推入過度複製，其中 DNA 複製叉以過高頻率起始並停滯或崩塌。這產生單股 DNA 缺口與複製壓力，活化檢查點激酶（ATR/ATM）與 DDR。在 OIS 中，此複製壓力是衰老誘發的核心上游事件，將癌基因活化連結到遺傳不穩定與停滯。它是 RAS 驅動衰老的關鍵機制前因。

source_document: _document_ - Small molecule compounds that induce cellular senescence.md

subject: DNA Replication Stress

context.en-US: Stalled or collapsed replication forks generate single-stranded DNA gaps that engage the ATR-CHK1 cascade, activating a checkpoint that senses replication stress. In oncogene-induced senescence, ATR signaling contributes to arrest and senescence establishment by stabilizing p53 and enforcing cell-cycle exit. The relationship is a canonical DNA-damage-checkpoint response and links oncogene-driven hyper-replication to cell-cycle enforcement. ATR is considered the primary sensor of replication stress.
context.zh-TW: 停滯或崩塌的複製叉產生單股 DNA 缺口，接合 ATR-CHK1 級聯，活化感知複製壓力的檢查點。在致癌基因誘發衰老中，ATR 訊號貢獻停滯與衰老建立，與 ATM 並行運作。此活化將複製壓力直接耦合到細胞週期退出，確保過度複製的細胞進入持久停滯。它是 OIS 中 DDR 驅動生長停止的核心組成。

source_document: _document_ - Small molecule compounds that induce cellular senescence.md

subject: DNA Replication Stress

context.en-US: DNA replication stress also activates the ATM-CHK2 cascade, converging on p53 stabilization and contributing to senescence induction alongside ATR. Dual ATM/ATR engagement ensures robust arrest under oncogenic stress, with ATM sensing double-strand breaks generated during fork collapse. The relationship positions replication stress as a trigger of both major DDR kinases and is supported by inhibitor and genetic studies in OIS. Together, the two cascades enforce the p53-dependent arrest that defines senescence.
context.zh-TW: DNA 複製壓力也活化 ATM-CHK2 級聯，匯聚於 p53 穩定並與 ATR 一起貢獻衰老誘發。ATM/ATR 雙重接合確保在致癌壓力下強健的停滯，其中 ATM 感知雙股斷裂而 ATR 感知單股缺口。此會聚將 DDR 激酶耦合到 p53 與 p16 臂，建立 OIS 的冗餘腫瘤抑制閘門。它是致癌基因誘發衰老的關鍵檢查點機制。

source_document: _document_ - Small molecule compounds that induce cellular senescence.md

context.en-US: The CDKN2A locus encoding p16INK4a is derepressed in OIS via loss of PRC1/2-mediated H3K27me3 repression, allowing p16 accumulation that enforces durable arrest. This epigenetic switch is a hallmark of the p53-independent senescence phase and locks cells into an Rb-dependent G1 block. The relationship couples oncogene signaling to stable CDK-inhibitor expression and is a well-characterized epigenetic event in OIS. It explains how senescence is maintained even when p53 is compromised, providing a second, independent barrier against escape.
context.zh-TW: 編碼 p16INK4a 的 CDKN2A 基因座在 OIS 中經由喪失 PRC1/2 介導的 H3K27me3 抑制而解抑制，允許 p16 累積以強制持久停滯。此表觀遺傳開關是 p53 獨立衰老階段的標記，並將細胞鎖入不可逆生長停止。其解抑制標記從急性壓力反應到穩定衰老表型的轉變，且與 p53 臂並行提供冗餘。它是 OIS 持久性的表觀遺傳基礎。

context.en-US: OIS cells transmit senescence to neighbouring normal cells via secreted SASP factors (Acosta et al., 2013), triggering paracrine senescence that amplifies the arrested field. This spread reinforces the tumor-suppressive barrier but can also promote pathology if chronic, and it was demonstrated in vivo in mouse liver and human sessile serrated adenomas. The relationship establishes OIS as a source of transmissible arrest and is a landmark, citation-backed finding in senescence biology. TGF-beta family ligands are the major paracrine mediators.
context.zh-TW: OIS 細胞透過分泌 SASP 因子（Acosta 等人，2013）將衰老傳遞至鄰近正常細胞，觸發旁分泌衰老以放大停滯場域。此擴散強化腫瘤抑制屏障，但在慢性脈絡中也可促進病理。透過將停滯擴展到周圍，OIS 將局部癌前病灶轉化為廣泛的生長抑制區，增強其作為癌症防禦的有效性。它是衰老可傳播性的關鍵例證。

context.en-US: OIS bypass requires loss of p53, p16INK4A, or PTEN, prerequisites for progression from arrested pre-malignancy to malignancy. Inactivation of these tumor suppressors releases the senescence brake, permitting proliferation of oncogene-stressed cells and enabling malignant transformation. The relationship underscores senescence as a barrier that must be overcome for cancer and is supported by co-mutation and knockout studies. Telomerase activation can also contribute to escape from arrest, further highlighting the multi-step nature of tumor progression.
context.zh-TW: OIS 迴避需要 p53、p16INK4A 或 PTEN 的缺失，這些是從停滯的癌前狀態進展到惡性所需的先決條件。這些腫瘤抑制因子的失活釋放衰老煞車，允許致癌壓力細胞增殖並啟動惡性轉化。此關係凸顯衰老作為失效安全屏障，且其崩潰是癌症進展的必要步驟。它是連結 OIS 到腫瘤抑制與其失效的核心機制。

context.en-US: OIS cells are susceptible to senolytic drugs like navitoclax (a BCL-2/BCL-XL inhibitor), which disable SCAPs and induce apoptosis in the arrested cells. This vulnerability reflects the SCAP dependence of senescent cells generally and provides a pharmacological route to eliminate OIS cells. The relationship supports the therapeutic concept of clearing oncogene-induced senescent cells to limit SASP-driven pathology, though removing premalignant senescent cells may paradoxically compromise tumor suppression. It is supported by senolytic efficacy studies in OIS models.
context.zh-TW: OIS 細胞對 navitoclax（一種 BCL-2/BCL-XL 抑制劑）等 senolytic 藥物敏感，其失能 SCAPs 並在停滯細胞中誘發凋亡。此脆弱性反映衰老細胞普遍對 SCAP 的依賴，並提供藥理清除致癌基因誘發衰老細胞的手段。透過標靶抗凋亡依賴，senolytics 可選擇性消除停滯的癌前細胞，支持以衰老清除作為癌症預防策略。它是 senotherapeutic 介入的關鍵機制。
